setting: At home, Ethan has written a song for Lena and nervously plays it for her.
lyrics:
I wanna dance like no one's watching me
I wanna love like it's the only thing I know
I wanna laugh from the bottom of my heart
I wanna sing like every single note and word it's all for you

Is this enough?

I wanna tell you and this is the only way I know
and hope one day you'll learn the words and say
That you finally see, what I see

Another song for you about your love
‘cause you love the me that's full of faults
I wish you could see it from this view
‘cause everything around you is a little bit brighter from your love

I wanna dance the night away with you
I wanna love because you taught me to
I wanna laugh all your tears away
I wanna sing ‘cause every single note and word it's just for you

Hope it's enough?

I wanna tell you and this is the only way I know
and hope one day you'll learn the words and say
That you finally see, how I feel

Another song for you about your love
‘cause you love the me that's full of faults
I wish you could see it from this view
‘cause everything around you is a little bit brighter from your love

Not a day goes by that I don't think
about you and the love you've given me
I wish you could see it from this view
‘cause everything around you is a little bit brighter from your love
Life is just so much better from your love

lyricConnections.explanationJa: 「誰も見ていない」。人目を気にせず行動していいと励ますときに使える。

lyricConnections.lyricExpression: from the bottom of my heart
lyricConnections.conversationExpression: from the bottom of my heart
lyricConnections.explanationJa: 「心の底から」。感謝や謝罪などの気持ちを強調できる。
「あなたが私に～を教えてくれた」。行動や考え方の変化を伝える表現。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I wrote a song for you, but I am nervous to play it.

conversation.japanese: 君のために曲を書いたんだけど、聴かせるのは緊張するよ。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Pretend no one's watching. It's just me.

conversation.japanese: 誰も見ていないと思って。ここには私しかいないよ。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart. You taught me to be brave enough to try.

conversation.japanese: 心の底から感謝を伝えたい。挑戦してみる勇気を君が教えてくれたんだ。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I didn't know I had that effect on you. You make my days brighter, too.

conversation.japanese: そんなふうに思ってくれていたなんて。あなたも私の毎日を明るくしてくれるよ。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I kept wondering if one song would be enough to say all that.

conversation.japanese: その気持ちを一曲で伝えきれるかなって、ずっと考えていた。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: It is enough. I can hear what you mean in every word.

conversation.japanese: 十分だよ。一つひとつの言葉から気持ちが伝わる。
